questionText: Consider a CPU that has to execute two types of processes. The first type, Actuators (A), requires a CPU burst of 6 seconds. The second type, Controllers (C), requires a CPU burst of 8 seconds. A new process of type A arrives at time $t = 10, 20, 30, 40$, and $50$ (in seconds). Similarly, a new process of type C arrives at time $t = 11, 22, 33, 44$, and $55$ (in seconds). The CPU scheduling policy is First Come First Serve (FCFS). The first process of type A starts running at $t = 10$ seconds. The average waiting time (in seconds) for the 10 processes is ________. (rounded off to one decimal place)
explanation:
Step 1: List all processes with their arrival times and burst times.
The processes arrive in the following order under First Come First Serve (FCFS):
- $A_1$: Arrival $t = 10$, Burst $= 6\text{ s}$
- $C_1$: Arrival $t = 11$, Burst $= 8\text{ s}$
- $A_2$: Arrival $t = 20$, Burst $= 6\text{ s}$
- $C_2$: Arrival $t = 22$, Burst $= 8\text{ s}$
- $A_3$: Arrival $t = 30$, Burst $= 6\text{ s}$
- $C_3$: Arrival $t = 33$, Burst $= 8\text{ s}$
- $A_4$: Arrival $t = 40$, Burst $= 6\text{ s}$
- $C_4$: Arrival $t = 44$, Burst $= 8\text{ s}$
- $A_5$: Arrival $t = 50$, Burst $= 6\text{ s}$
- $C_5$: Arrival $t = 55$, Burst $= 8\text{ s}$

Step 2: Calculate start time, completion time, and waiting time for each process.
Waiting Time $(\text{WT}) = \text{Start Time} - \text{Arrival Time}$

- $A_1$: Starts at $10$, Finishes at $16$. $\text{WT} = 10 - 10 = 0\text{ s}$
- $C_1$: Starts at $16$, Finishes at $24$. $\text{WT} = 16 - 11 = 5\text{ s}$
- $A_2$: Starts at $24$, Finishes at $30$. $\text{WT} = 24 - 20 = 4\text{ s}$
- $C_2$: Starts at $30$, Finishes at $38$. $\text{WT} = 30 - 22 = 8\text{ s}$
- $A_3$: Starts at $38$, Finishes at $44$. $\text{WT} = 38 - 30 = 8\text{ s}$
- $C_3$: Starts at $44$, Finishes at $52$. $\text{WT} = 44 - 33 = 11\text{ s}$
- $A_4$: Starts at $52$, Finishes at $58$. $\text{WT} = 52 - 40 = 12\text{ s}$
- $C_4$: Starts at $58$, Finishes at $66$. $\text{WT} = 58 - 44 = 14\text{ s}$
- $A_5$: Starts at $66$, Finishes at $72$. $\text{WT} = 66 - 50 = 16\text{ s}$
- $C_5$: Starts at $72$, Finishes at $80$. $\text{WT} = 72 - 55 = 17\text{ s}$

Step 3: Compute total and average waiting time.
$$\text{Total Waiting Time} = 0 + 5 + 4 + 8 + 8 + 11 + 12 + 14 + 16 + 17 = 95\text{ s}$$
$$\text{Average Waiting Time} = \frac{95}{10} = 9.5\text{ s}$$

Thus, the average waiting time is 9.5 seconds.
